Red Bull Energy Drink was officially released on April 1, 1987, when it was launched in Austria [d1][d2][d5]. The company behind it, Red Bull GmbH, had actually been founded earlier, in 1984, by Dietrich Mateschitz [d2][d6]. The 1987 launch is widely described as not just the introduction of a new product, but the birth of an entirely new product category — energy drinks [d3][d9]. Following its Austrian debut, Red Bull expanded internationally through the early 1990s, entering Hungary and Slovenia in 1992 and Germany and the UK in 1994 [d8], before launching in the United States in 1996–1997 [d9][d8].
